subtitle: External audio ingestion: directory mirror sync (local/OpenList) + upstream push + FunASR

overview.checkWatchNoSource: Enabled but no source (watch_dir or OpenList)
overview.checkIngestHint: Optional: set audiosync_ingest_token for upstream push

recordings.rebuildConfirm: All transcript segments and voiceprint samples of this unit will be cleared, then re-parsed by the audio-sync component (speaker attribution rebuilt). Continue?

outcome.deleted: Source no longer exists; registration and segments cleared
outcome.excluded: Path matches exclusion rules; not rebuilt

sync.title: Directory auto-sync
sync.noSource: No sync source configured (audiosync_watch_dir or OpenList)
sync.enableHint: Enable audiosync_watch_enabled and set audiosync_watch_dir (NAS mount) or OpenList in Settings

empty.recordingsHint: Enable directory sync in Settings and configure the NAS audio directory; new recordings will be ingested automatically

messages.syncStarted: Sync started in background, progress refreshes automatically
messages.syncAlreadyRunning: Sync already in progress, progress refreshes automatically

funasr.title: FunASR transcribe service
funasr.desc: Self-hosted service for transcription / streaming ASR / voiceprint; takes effect immediately after saving
funasr.modelNote: Voiceprint vectors are extracted by this service (model & dims decided server-side, e.g. SenseVoice service uses cam++ 192-d); swap models on the server, only the address is configured here

gpu.title: GPU model memory
gpu.hint: Model-level start/stop: process stays alive after release; models auto-reload on the next voice/face inference — free VRAM before running large models
gpu.unloaded: VRAM released; auto-reloads on next inference
gpu.unsupported: Service does not support model-level start/stop (upgrade voicehub)
gpu.unloadAllConfirm: Releases all models (moss / asr / diarize / embedder). Processes stay alive; models auto-reload on next inference.
